title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos

layout.note: four rounded grey panels fitted like a jigsaw: panel 1 is L-shaped and wraps around the top of panel 3, panel 2 sits top-centre, panel 3 is wide at the bottom-centre, panel 4 is tall at the right; digit tabs give the order and no arrows join the panels; each panel also has a title

lesson: One accent hue on the model boxes and arrows over grey frames and full-colour photo tiles keeps a dense, photographic overview readable; numbered corner tabs order a jigsaw of panels with no inter-panel arrows.
